subject: Environment handshake: API key rotation plan & VPC peering window
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Li <alex.li@healthsync.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Environment handshake: API keys, rotation, and peering window

Alex — thanks again for the time today. Per our MAP, we want to lock the environment handoff and the technical cutover timeline. Below is the minimal set of steps we need from HealthSync and our owners at Redwood to make the POC environment go live: 

- Org bootstrap: create tenant `healthsync-eval` and confirm admin contact for SSO (if applicable).
- API keys: we will provision two sets — ephemeral test keys and a longer-lived staging key. HealthSync to confirm preferred rotation cadence (we recommend 7 days for ephemeral, 90 days for staging).
- IP allowlist: please provide the egress IP CIDR ranges for your dev VPN and any on-prem hosts that will call the Redwood API. We will provide our allowlist block for inbound peering.
- VPC peering: target window is Fri 8/8 02:00–06:00 UTC (low traffic). We need a contact at your infra team for the peering handshake and a shared acceptance test (simple token exchange + ping/route verification).

Ask: can you confirm these items by EOD Thu 7/31 so we can schedule the peering window? If any of these need different ownership, call them out and we will update the MAP.

Attachments: redwood_map_summary.pdf (one-pager), healthsync_network_diagram_v1.png (attachment stub)

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: Alex Li <alex.li@healthsync.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: eng@healthsync.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Environment handshake: API keys, rotation, and peering window

Karthik — thanks for the summary. Quick answers inline:

- Org bootstrap: we can create `healthsync-eval` and I will add Megan (megan@healthsync.com) as admin.
- API keys: 7-day ephemeral sounds fine for dev tokens; 180 days for staging keys (security prefers slightly longer for this POC).
- IP allowlist: sending current egress blocks below — these are our dev and staging NAT ranges.
  - 34.82.16.0/20
  - 35.190.0.0/17

- VPC peering window: 8/8 is OK from our side but our infra lead is on PTO that week; can we move to 8/10 01:00–05:00 UTC? If not, we will nominate an alternate.

I'll follow up with Megan and our infra lead on the exact peering contact.

— Alex
Principal Engineer, HealthSync
alex.li@healthsync.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Environment handshake: API keys, rotation, and peering window

Looping back with a checklist for ops so we don't miss anything when HealthSync confirms: 

1) Tenant provisioning: ensure `healthsync-eval` is created in staging and linked to their account id HS-2025-037. Owner: Neha.
2) API key flow: generate two key types in Vault — `hs-ephemeral-<uuid>` (TTL 7d) and `hs-staging-<uuid>` (TTL 180d). Add rotation job and webhook that posts events to our Audit Logs. Owner: Jordan.
3) Allowlist: Andrew in infra will add HealthSync CIDRs to the inbound list for the test cluster. Need Alex to confirm any proxy or NAT exemptions. Owner: Neha.
4) Peering: schedule a dry-run 24 hours before the window to validate BGP/route tables and firewall rules. Create acceptance test doc (token exchange + curl to /health endpoint). Owner: Jordan.

I'll prepare the acceptance doc and a step-by-step runbook. Karthik — once Alex confirms the window, can you lock calendar invites and create the peering ticket?

Neha Kapoor
Senior PM, Onboarding | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Li <alex.li@healthsync.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Environment handshake: API keys, rotation, and peering window

Alex — appreciate the quick reply and the CIDRs. 8/10 01:00–05:00 UTC works for us; I've penciled it in and will send official invites once Megan confirms admin access. 

Next steps (owners & due dates):
- Alex / HealthSync: add Megan as admin & share peering contact (due: 2025-07-31 17:00 UTC)
- Jordan: prepare ephemeral/staging keys & add rotation hooks (due: 2025-08-04)
